messages:
incidents-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate observed for Redwood Hosted API in eu-west-1 and increased latency for Dedicated pools (metric spike at 2024-07-15T11:00Z). Affected endpoints: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings. Auto-notifications sent to #incidents and oncall.

morgan: seeing the same in dashboards — 5xx ~8% P95 latency up ~2.3s. A lot of STS errors in auth-proxy logs.

samira: @sre-oncall I'm on it, taking pager. Starting root channel. Can folks post short impact notes so we can triage?

sre-oncall: joining. Confirming customer impact: a handful of hosted customers report timeouts; Dedicated pools showing elevated queueing, throughput reduced ~30%.

jamie: logs show upstream AWS STS 500s and some ELB TLS handshake failures in eu-west-1. cc @kevin re networking.

kevin: we've got NAT gateway error rates and elevated conntrack drops for some subnets in eu-west-1 — looks like a regional egress problem to STS endpoints. AWS status page shows degraded for that region.

eli: quick mitigation options: 1) enable cross-region routing for affected Hosted API tenants 2) failover Dedicated pools to eu-west-2/ca-central temporarily 3) increase retry/backoff in auth-proxy (short term). Which do we want now?

samira: prioritize customer-facing mitigation: 1) enable cross-region routing for the hosted control plane (canary 10% -> 50%) 2) start Dedicated pool failover for high-impact customers pre-approved for cross-region 3) communications: send ICS to support + status page.

morgan: I'll open ticket for support comms. @liz can you draft a short status blurb?

liz: draft posted in #support-daily-digest — "We are experiencing elevated errors in eu-west-1 due to a third-party (AWS) regional issue. Engineers are actively failing over traffic and some customers may see increased latency or reconnects. Will update in 30m."

ops-bot: deploy job queued: route-policy:eu-west-1->eu-west-2 canary=0.10 by morgan. ETA ~3m.

jamie: config to flip routing (example):
```
POST /admin/routing/policies
{
  "policy": "eu-west-1-failover",
  "target": "eu-west-2",
  "canary_fraction": 0.1
}
```

eli: also bumping auth-proxy retries to 5 with jitter for requests hitting STS; patch pushed to canary hosts.

samira: oncall note: we'll monitor error rate and P95. If 5xx doesn't drop below 1% in 15m, escalate to full 50% routing.

kevin: FYI AWS console shows STS throttling for certain AZ egress IPs. We're seeing routing to alternate NATs reduce errors for some hosts.

morgan: can we identify Dedicated customers with strict region requirements? We should avoid moving them.

jamie: list pulled — two Dedicated customers are locked to eu-west-1 via contract (cust-A, cust-B). We'll not force failover for those; contacting account teams now.

liz: support update queued to customers impacted by increased latency (CS contacting top 10).

samira: monitoring: error rate dropped to 3.5% after canary 10% shift, P95 down 0.9s — still elevated. Increasing canary to 40% now.

ops-bot: route-policy change applied: canary -> 0.4.

eli: auth-proxy metrics show retries reducing visible 5xx by ~30% for retried tokens, but we need region failover to fully mitigate.

morgan: heads-up — we're seeing a handful of customer 5xx traces tied to long-running KV cache misses during region failover. Jamie, can we bump cache TTL for the failover window?

jamie: TTL bumped on canary hosts to 60s. Also enabling extra logging to capture trace ids for the affected requests.

samira: timeframe: continuing live mitigation. Next status update + ETA for full mitigation in 20m. If AWS resolves before then, we'll roll back routing.

eli: postmortem owner? I can start a timeline. Assign to: eli (owner), samira (oncall notes), jamie (technical writeup).

morgan: thanks — I'll coordinate customer comms and account handoffs.

incidents-bot: NOTE: Pager handoff scheduled at 2024-07-15T12:00Z to next oncall.

samira: handing to next oncall in 40m. Leaving this channel open for any escalations.

kevin: AWS just published "Increased error rates for STS in eu-west-1" in their console. Status page: https://status.aws.amazon.com/incidents/12345 — ETA unknown.

eli: final quick note: create a short runbook item for future STS egress spikes (routing + retry guidance). I'll add to infra-runbooks.

morgan: thanks team. I'll post full exit/update in 30m with customer impact summary.

incidents-bot: RESOLVED: Partial mitigation achieved via cross-region routing; total error rate back to ~0.8% after 40% routing shift. Incident remains open pending AWS resolution and postmortem.
